vya_text: dI0 - pUrvamuktaM ‘BaiShajyAKyAnakaM tathA’ iti, idAnIM taddarSayannAha -BaiShajyasya AKyAnakaM BakShaNakAlAdikathanam – tadadhikRutyAha - BaiShajyamiti | budho BaiShajyaM prAyaSo bAhulyena praBAte aByavaharet BakShayedityarthaH | BiShajA saMstutaM dravyaM BaiShajyam | budha ityanena auShadhakAlAn vIkShya svabuddhyA SIlayedityarthaH | nAtra praBAtameva sarveShAM niyatakAlam | ata eva vakShyante atraiva viSeShAH | yathA - kaShAyAMSca viSeSheNeti | viSeShagrahaNena kaShAyAn prAtarevAByavaharet nAnyatra | kaShAyAniti bahuvacanena svarasAdayaH pa~jcakaShAyasaMj~jakA j~jAtavyAH, tadyathA - ‘svarasaH kalpaniryUhau himaPANTau ca viSrutAH’ iti | tatra auShadhaBakShaNe BedaH kAlaBedo darSitaH kathita ityarthaH | vakShyamANa iti SeShaH || 1 ||
gU0 - prAyaSo bAhulyena praBAte BaiShajyam avaharet prayojayet viSeShataH kaShAyAMSca prayojayet | tatra Bedastu darSitaH ‘kAlenukte praBAtaM syA’dityatra || 1 ||

pada: atha BaiShajyAKyAnakAdhyAyaH | BaiShajyamaByavaharetpraBAte prAyaSo budhaH | kaShAyAMSca viSeSheNa tatra Bedastu darSitaH || 1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM tadBedamAha - j~jeya iti | BaiShajyagrahaNe auShadhaBakShaNanimitte nRuNAM pa~jcavidhaH pa~jcaprakAraH kAlaH samayo j~jeyaH | etaccAtipAtivyAdhiShu na kAlaniyama ityeke BAShante, yataH ‘atipAtiShu rogeShu necCedvidhimimaM BiShak | pradIptAgAravacCIGraM tataH kuryAt pratikriyAm’ iti | satyaM, tathApi kartavyametat | atha pa~jcaprakArAnAha – ki~jciditi | tatra kiMcit sUryodaye jAte sati ekaH kAlaH, sa tu prAyaSaH kaShAyArthamAdau pratipAditaH; ‘kaShAyArthaM viSeSheNa’ iti vacanAt | dvitIyastu divasaBojane BeShajakAlaH sa pa~jcavidho Bavati | BojanAgre yathA lavaNArdrakaM BojanamiSraM yathA hi~gguGRutAdikaM, Bojanamadhye yathA pAnIyAdikaM, BojanAnte yathA lava~ggaharItakyAdi BojanapUrvAnte ceti yathA dhAtrIlohamalapitte | tRutIyakAlastu sandhyAsamayaBojane j~jeyaH, so ~api trividhaH grAse grAsAntare#foot@‘BaktAdau, Baktamadhye, BaktAnte’ pA0 |# BuktAnte ceti sa cAnumAnato boddhavyaH | caturthakAlastu vAraMvAraM kathitaH, sa dvividhaH, tatra dravyaM sAnnaM nirannaM ceti | pa~jcamaH kAlastu niSi rAtrau boddhavyaH||2||

gU0 - atha pa~jcavidhakAlaH - tamAha - nRuNAM BaiShajyagrahaNe BakShaNArthe pa~jcavidhaH kAlo j~jeyaH - ki~jcitsUryodaye jAte prathamakAlo j~jeyaH | tathA tena prakAreNa divasaBojanena madhyAhne dvitIyaH kAlo j~jeyaH | ca punaH sAyantane Bojane tRutIyaprahare tRutIyaH kAlo j~jeyaH | muhuH ko ~arthaH - caturthaprahare caturthaH kAlo j~jeyaH | atra muhuravyayam | caturthapraharArdhe darSitaH | niSi sandhyAyAM pa~jcamaH kAlo j~jeyaH | iti pa~jcakAlAnAmanukramaNikA || 2 ||

pada: j~jeyaH pa~jcavidhaH kAlo BaiShajyagrahaNe nRuNAm | ki~jcitsUryodaye jAte tathA divasaBojane || 2 || sAyantane Bojane ca muhuScApi tathA niSi |

vya_text: dI0 - atha teShAM pratyekaM viSeShavivaraNamAha - prAya iti | pittakaPodreke sati virekavamanArthayoH dravyaM praBAte BakShayedityaBiprAyaH | yathA pittodreke virekaH kaPodreke vamanam iti | udreko doShotkaTaH | anyathA asmin kAle ~api vamanavirekayorna niShedhaH | tathAhi ‘sadyoBuktasya vA jAte jvare sAme viSeShataH | vamanaM vamanArhasya SastamityAha vAgBaTaH’ ityAdivacanAt | vamanAtiyogena virekaM mRudu kArayet ityapi na kevalaM vamanavirekanimittam | leKanArthaM ca prAtareva leKanaM pattalIkaraNaM puruShANAM doShANAM ca | puruShANAM yathAsthUlasya madhvambunA, doShANAM yathA - vAyostailaM, pittasya GRutaM, kaPasya madhu iti | evamiti parisamAptaH prathamaH kAlaH || 3-4 ||

gU0 - atha prathamakAlaH | prAyaH atiSayena kaPodreke pittakaPAdhikye virekavamanArthayoH, ca punaH leKanArthe kRuSIkaraNArthe medorogAdau dantadhAvanArthe ca | tatra BaiShajyaM praBAte samAharet BakShayedityarthaH | evam, amunA prakAreNa BaiShajyagrahaNe prathamaH kAlaH syAt iti prathamaH || 3 || 4 ||

pada: prAyaH pittakaPodreke virekavamanArthayoH || 3 || leKanArthaM ca BaiShajyaM praBAte tatsamAharet | evaM syAtprathamaH kAlo BaiShajyagrahaNe nRuNAm || 4 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha dvitIyakAlamAha - BaiShajyamiti | apAne gudasthite vAte viguNe kruddhe BojanAgre BuktAdau BakShayedBaiShajyamiti SeShaH | arucau satyAM citraBojyairmanoj~javya~jjanAdikaiH saha miSraM militaM ruciraM rucikaraM yathA syAttathA BakShayedBaiShajyamiti pUrvavanmantavyam | samAnavAte nABisthite vAyau viguNe prakupite satyagnimAndye ~api ca agnidIpanamagnikaraM dravyaM Bojanamadhye dadyAdityarthaH | tathA hikkAkShepakakampeShu satsu Bojanasya pUrvamante ca dadyAt | AkShepako vAtaroge paThitaH, kampo ~api vAtaroge || 5-7 ||

gU0 - apAne gudasthe vAyau viguNe sati BaiShajyaM madhyAhne BojanAgre BojanAdau praSasyate yujyate | dvitIye kAle madhyAhne iti sarvatraiva yojyam | arucau satyAM citraBojyaiH saha ruciram auShadhaM miSram annayuktaM yathA syAttathA Aharet prayojayet | citraBojyaiH nAnAvya~jjanaiH, samAnavAte nABisthe vAyau, mande ~agnau ca sati agnidIpanaBaiShajyaM kuSalo BiShak Bojanamadhye dadyAt| kuSalo BiShak vaidyakaSAstre nipuNaH | vyAnakope sarvaSarIrasthe vAyau kupite sati BaiShajyamauShadhaM BojanAnte Bojanamadhye samAharedyojayet| hikkAkShepakakampeShvadhikeShu satsu BojanAtpUrvaM ante ca BaiShajyaM yojayediti SeShaH | AkShepakaH vAyuH | evamamunA prakAreNa dvitIyaH kAlaH BaiShajyakarmaNi proktaH || 5-7 ||

pada: BaiShajyaM viguNe ~apAne BojanAgre praSasyate | arucau citraBojyaiSca miSraM ruciramAharet || 5 || samAnavAte viguNe mande ~agnAvagnidIpanam | dadyAdBojanamadhye ca BaiShajyaM kuSalo BiShak || 6 || vyAnakope ca BaiShajyaM BojanAnte samAharet | hikkAkShepakakampeShu pUrvamante ca BojanAt || 7 || evaM dvitIyakAlaSca prokto BaiShajyakarmaNi |

vya_text: dI0 - atha tRutIyakAlamAha - udAne iti | udAne kaNThasthite vAte kupite, kathaMBUte svaraBa~ggAdikAriNi, svaraBa~ggo vikRutasvaratvaM mUkatvaM vA, AdigrahaNAt kaNThagatarogANAM grahaNam | sAndhyaBojane sandhyAsamayaBojane ~agre grAse kavale grAsAntare kavalayormadhye BeShajyaM deyamityaBiprAyaH | tathA prANe hRudayasthite prANavAte praduShTe sati sAndhyasya BuktasyAhArasya ante prAnte auShadhaM deyamityarthaH | dhIrairiti gamBIrabuddhiBiH puruShaiH | ayaM tRutIyaH kAlaH syAjjAnIyAt | nanu kathaM vAyoH prANAdayaH pa~jcaBedA darSitAH pittakaPayostu nodAhRutAH? ucyate - anilastu doShadhAtumalAdInAM pradhAnatamaH prakopakAraNahetuSca ata evAsya prakopeNa pittakaPayoH prakopa eva ‘ekaH prakupito doShaH sarvAneva prakopayet’ iti vacanAt | anyadapi ‘svayamBUreSha BagavAn vAyurityaBiSabditaH | acintyavIryo doShANAM netA rogasamUharAT’ ||8-9 ||

gU0 - udAne kaNThasthe vAyau kupite sAndhyaBojane tRutIyaprahare BaiShajyaM grAsagrAsAntare deyam | BUte udAne svaraBa~ggAdikAraNaM SIlaM yasya tasmin hRudisthe prANavAte praduShTe sati sAndhyasya BuktasyAnte tRutIyapraharamadhye dhIraiH prAyaSo bAhulyena auShadhaM dIyate | ityayaM tRutIyaH kAlaH syAt | iti tRutIyakAlaH || 8 || 9 ||

pada: udAne kupite vAte svaraBa~ggAdikAriNi || 8 || grAse grAsAntare deyaM BaiShajyaM sAndhyaBojane | prANe praduShTe sAndhyasya BuktasyAnte ca dIyate || 9 || auShadhaM prAyaSo dhIraiH kAlo ~ayaM syAttRutIyakaH |

vya_text: gU0 - muhusturye prahare ko ~arthaH | punaH tRuTCardihikkASvAsagareShu sAnnaM BeShajam | tRuT tRuShNA, garaM viSham | iti caturthaH ||10||

pada: muhurmuhuSca tRuTCardihikkASvAsagareShu ca || 10 || sAnnaM ca BeShajaM dadyAditi kAlaScaturthakaH |

vya_text: dI0 - atha caturthakAlamAha -muhurmuhurityAdi | tRuDAdiShu satsu muhurmuhurvAraMvAraM sAnnamiti BaktamiSritaM dravyaM dadyAt | cakArAt kvacinnirannavyavahArAnna doShaH | tRuT tRuShNA, garamatra viSham | iti caturthaH kAlaH || 10 ||

dI0 - atha pa~jcamakAlamAha - Urdhveti | rAtrau pAcanaSamanarUpamauShadhaM cAnnarahitaM deyamiti BAvaH | kutra ? UrdhvajatruvikAreShu tathA leKane bRuMhaNe ca jatru grIvAmUlaM, tadUrdhvavikArAH SirorogAdayaH | tathAca - ‘Urdhvajatrujaroge tu sAyaM syAdavalehikA’ ityAdivacanAt leKanaM pravRuddharogANAM hrasvAnAM bRuMhaNamiti kShINadoShavardhanamiti BAvaH | niSIti sAmAnyena sakalarAtrAvityeke BAShante, saMpradAne tu prathamaM yAmaM varamityarthaH | ‘iti pa~jcamakAlaH syAt’| ityasya sthAne ‘ityevaM pa~jcamaH kAlaH’ pAThaH sAdhuH | BaiShajyahetave dravyaBakShaNanimitte ityevaM pa~jcamaH kAlaH kathitaH || 11 || 12 ||

gU0 - UrdhvajatruvikAreShu satsu tathA karaNIye leKane bRuMhaNe ~arthe pAcanaM dravyaM sthAnAnmalasa~jcayamUrdhvamadho vA yannayettacCamanam ityayaM BaiShajyahetave pa~jcamakAlaH proktaH | iti pa~jcamakAlaH || 11 || 12 ||

pada: UrdhvajatruvikAreShu leKane bRuMhaNe tathA || 11 || pAcanaM SamanaM deyamanannaM BeShajaM niSi | iti pa~jcamakAlaH syAt prokto BaiShajyakarmaNi||12||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM dravye rasAdInAM viSeShAvasthAmAha - dravya iti | dravye pradhAnaBUte rasAdayaH pa~jcA ~avasthAH kathitAH, saMbandhena kramAditi j~jAnakramAt, tASca rasaguNavIryavipAkapraBAvAdayo rasAH ShaT madhurAdayaste tu madhurAmlalavaNatiktoShaNakaShAyAH | guNA viMSatiH - te yathA-guru-manda-hima-snigdha-SlakShNa-sAndra-mRudu-sthira-sUkShma-viSadA iti daSa; viparyayAstu - laGu-tIkShNoShNarUkShaKaradravakaThinasarasthUlapicCilAH; evaM viMSatiguNAH kathitAH | vIryamiti dvividhaM SItamuShNaM ceti| kecidaShTavidhamAhuH - SItoShNasnigdharUkShaviSadapicCilamRudu tIkShNaM ceti, yataH - ‘vIryasaMj~jA guNA hyete te ~api dravyASrayA matAH’ iti vacanAt| vipAkastu trividhaH svAdvamlakaTukAtmaka iti | kecidgurulaGudvAreNa dvividhamAhuH | tatra madhuraH kaTukAtmakaH yato madhurAKyo guruH kaTukAKyo laGuriti | SaktiScAcintyapraBAvo dravyANAM yathA maNimantrauShadhInAM vidhiH | ete ~api rasAdayo dravyASritA Bavanti tasmAddravyaM pradhAnamityAhuH | yaduktaM ‘pAko nAsti vinA vIryAdvIryaM nAsti vinA rasAt | raso nAsti vinA dravyAddravyaM SreShThatamaM smRutam’ iti | dravyamiti sAmAnyagrahaNena mUlatvaksAraniryAsAdInyaBidhIyante | tadyathA - ‘mUlatvaksAraniryAsanAlasvarasapallavAH | kShIraM kShAraM PalaM puShpaM Basma tailAni kaNTakam || patrANi SRu~ggakandAni prarohAstUdBidAdayaH | dravyaSabdena gRuhyante ja~ggamAH pArthivAstathA ||’ iti | ja~ggamA api yathA - ‘madhUni gorasAH pittaM vasA majjA ~asRugAmiSham | viNmUtracarmareto ~asthi snAyuSRu~gganaKaM KurAH || ja~ggameByaH prayujyante keSA lomAni rocanAH’ iti | pArthivASca yathA - ‘suvarNaM samalAH pa~jca lohASceti kalAsu ca | manaH SilAle maNayo lavaNaM gairikA~jjanam’ ityAdi || atha teShAM rasAdInAM svarUpamAha - madhura iti | madhurAdayaH ShaDrasA dravyASritAH santo ~api vyAKyAtA eva | tatra madhuro GRutaguDAdiH, amlo amlIkAmAtulu~ggAdiH, paTurlavaNaparyAyaH sa ca saindhavAdiH, kaTuko marIcAdiH, tikto nimbAdiH, kaShAyo harItakyAdiH || eteShAM mUrtInAmutpattimAha - dharetyAdi | utpatistu BUtadvayena Bavati | BUtaM pRuthivyAdi | kramAditi yuktakrameNa tadyathA - dharAmbuByAM madhuro rasaH, tena pRuthivyambubAhulyena madhurarasa utpadyate, evaM kShmA ~analAByAmamlaH, jalajvalanAByAM lavaNaH, AkASamarudByAM kaTukaH, vAyvagniByAM tiktaH, kShmA ~anilAByAM kaShAya iti rasaH || atha guNAH - gururiti | gurusnigdhAdayo guNAH kramAt dharAdInAM kathitAH | kramo yathA - dharAyA guruH, ambunaH snigdhaH, vahnestIkShNaH, pavanasya rUkShaH, vyomno laGuriti | prAya iti prAyeNa ete ~atra muKyA guNA guNAnAM madhye kathitAH | pa~jcaguNagrahaNaM BUtakrameNa kRutam | eShveva pa~jcaguNeShu anyo ~api SlakShNasAndramRudupraBRutiguNasaMcayo boddhavyaH | sa cApyanumAnato nirUpaNIyaH | guNA iti bahuvacanatvena vyavAyI vikAsI cAkarau dvau dvAviMSatyarthamiti kecit, satvaM rajastamaSceti trayo mahAguNAH kathitA iti kaiScit || atha vIryam - vIryamiti SaktiH | taddvividhamapi prAyaSo bAhulyena dravyASrayaM dravyAdhInaM Bavati | dvividhaM SItoShNaBedena | yasmAdBuvanatrayamagnyAtmakaM somAtmakaM ca dRuSyate | atraiva SItoShNavIrye anyAni yAni vIryANi tAnyantarBaviShyantIti kecit vadanti na svamatam, yataH prAyaSa iti grahaNena SItoShNaM viSiShTavIryam | anyAnIti snigdharUkShaviSadapicCilamRudutIkShNAdIni mahABUtAni tu kShmAmbujvalanAkASamarutaH || atha vipAkamAha - miShTa iti | prAyaSo bAhulyenAtra trividha eva vipAkaH madhuro ~amlaH kaTuka iti | viSiShTo pAko vipAkastatra miShTo madhuraH paTurlavaNa etayormadhura iti madhuravipAka ityaBiprAyaH | amlo ~amlamiti | amlo rasaH amlameva pacyate | kaTutiktakaShAyANAM rasAnAM kaTuriti kaTukavipAkaH syAt | etadaBiprAyeNa tantrAntare coktam ‘tridhA vipAko dravyasya svAdvamlakaTukAtmakaH’ iti | ata eva vipAkAnAM trividhaM karma Bavati | tadAha -madhurAdityAdi | madhurAnmadhuravipAkAt SleShmA prajAyate prakopamApadyate ityarthaH | amlAccetyamlavipAkAt pittamiti | kaTukAditi kaTukavipAkAdvAyuriti | etAni karmANi yat kurvanti tat karma, karmaSabdenAtra doShaprakopavyApAralakShaNaM dharma iti || idAnIM praBAvamAha - praBAva iti | viSiShTo BAva utkRuShTA SaktirityarthaH | yathA dhAtrI AmalakIPalaM rasAdiBiriti rasaguNavIryavipAkAdiBiH samA samAnaguNA laGurapyasti tathApi tadevAmalakIPalaM praBAvAddoShatrayanASanaM niyatameva | iti rasAdipraBAvaH || kevalaM dravyapraBAvamAha - kvacidityAdi | kutrApi kevalamekadravyameva praBAvataH karma kuryAt | yathA sahadevIjaTA SirobaddhA satI jvaraM hantIti | ata evAcintyo maNimantrauShadhInAM praBAva iti viSrutiH | eke ‘praBAvastu yathA dhAtrIlakucasya rasAdiBiri’ti paThanti | tatra lakucaPalasya rasAdiBiH saha dhAtrI samAnadharmA, tatrApi dhAtrI praBAvAdeva doShatrayanASinI Bavati | lakucaPalam - lakucaH kShudrapanasaH, nAra~ggaPalamityeke || 13-23 || atha dravyASritAnAM rasAdInAM nijotkRuShTatAmAha - kvaciditi | dravyamASritya sthitA ye rasAdayaste svaM svaM karma kurvanti | kvacidrasa iti yathA - tiktA guDUcI uShNavIryApi pittaM Samayati | kvacidguNo yathA - kaTukaM mUlakaM SleShmANaM ca vardhayati snigdhaguNatvAt | kvacidvIryamiti yathA - mahatpa~jcamUlaM kaShAyaM tiktAnurasaM vAtaM Samayati uShNavIryatvAt | nanu guNavIryayoH ko BedaH? ucyate, ya eva guNA dhAtrIPale ta eva harItakyAM santi | vIrye viSeSho ~asti yataH uShNavIryA harItakIM SItavIryaM dhAtrIPalamiti, tasmAdBinnatvaM pratipAditamiti na doShaH | kvacidvipAka iti yaddravyaM pariNAmakAle svABAvikaM rasaM parityajya rasAntaraM Bajate tatra vipAketi saMj~jA, yathA SuNThI kaTukApi vAtaM Samayati madhurapAkatvAt | kvacit Saktiriti | yathA SaktitaH praBAvataH yato rasaguNavIryavipAkairyat karma kartuM na Sakyate tatkarma kurvan praBAva iti saMj~jA, yathA KadiraH kuShThaM hanti | ata evAha suSrutaH - ‘amImAMsyAnyacintyAni prasiddhAni svaBAvataH | AgamenopayojyAni BeShajAni vicakShaiNaiH’ || iti dravyAdikathanam || 13-23 ||

doShopacayaprakopopaSamanimittaM ‘te tu BAdrapadAdyena dvimAsikena varShAdayo vyAKyAtAH’ yathAyathaM saMKyAtAH | ye tu tantrAntare - ‘mAsairdvisaMKyairmAGAdyai’rityAdinA SiSiravasantagrIShmavarShASaraddhemantA Bavanti te tu SItoShNavarShalakShaNAScandrAdityayoH kAlaviBAgakaratvAccAyananimittAH | yataH ‘mAsarASisvarUpAKyamRutau yallakShaNatrayami’ti vacanAt | nanu prAvRuDvarShayoH ko BedaH? ucyate, prathamaH pravRuttaH kAlaH prAvRuT tasyAnubandho varShA ityatra BedaH | evaM ‘SiSire SItamadhikaM raukShyaM cAdAnakAlajam’ ityanena SiSirahemantayorapi Bedo ~asti | pUrvamuktaM cayakopasamA Rutavo BavantIti || tayormadhyamadhye Adau suSrutAdiShvapyuktatvAt kevalaprakope RutumAha - te SiSiravasantagrIShmavarShASaraddhemantAH teShAM mAGaPAlgunau SiSiraH, caitravaiSAKau vasantaH, jyeShThAShADhau grIShmaH, SrAvaNaBAdrapadau varShA, ASvinakArtikau Sarat, mArgapauShau hemanta iti | ete SItoShNavarShalakShaNAScandrAdityayoH kAlaviBAgakaratvAt | ayane dve Bavato dakShiNamuttaraM ca | tayordakShiNaM varShASaraddhemantAsteShu Bagavansoma ApyAyate sAmlalavaNamadhurASca balavanto Bavanti uttarottaraM ca sarvaprANinAM balamaBivardhate | uttaraM ca SiSiravasantagrIShmAsteShu BagavAnarka ApyAyate tiktakaTukaShAyA rasA balavanto Bavanti uttarottaraM ca sarvaprANinAM balamapahIyate | Bavati cAtra ‘SItAMSuH kledayetpUrvAM vivasvAn SoShayatyapi | tAvuBAvapi saMsRujya vAyuH pAlayati prajAH ||’ iti | meShavRuShau etau dvau rASI grIShmaH proktaH, mithunakarkayoretayordvayo rASyoH prAvRuT , siMhakanye ete dve varShAH smRutA, tulAvRuScikayoH Sarat Bavati, dhanurgrAhau dvau hemantaH proktaH, kumBamInayormadhye vasantaH proktaH | nanu SiSiraM vihAya prAvRuTgrahaNaM kimiti kriyate nahi atra SiSirastu hemante praviShTaH SleShmaNaScayahetutvAt | yadi SiSiraH hemante na praviSati tadA SleShmaNaScayAt vasantaM vihAya kaPasya kopaH SiSire syAt | nanvanye ~api carakAdayo granthAH santi SiSiraM hemante ekIkartuM kenApi na Sakyate BavadBiH kathaM kriyate tadatrAsminnAyurveda yatra dvau samavetau BavataH tatra SiSirastu hemante prayoktavyaH, varShAprAvRuShorBedaH kartavyaH prathamo varShAkAlaH prAvRuT tadanukaraNaM, tasya prAvRuSho ~a~ggam | yadAha suSrutaH ‘iha tu varShASaraddhemantavasantagrIShmaprAvRuShaH ShaT Rutavo Bavanti doShopacayaprakopopaSamanimittaM te tu BAdrapadAdyena dvimAsikena samAKyAtAH | yatra cayasamAvetau na staH kopa evAsti tatra prAvRuT vihAya SiSirasahitAH ShaT RutavaH santi | tadAha granthAntare ‘hemantavarShASiSireShu vAyoH pittasya varShAsu nidAGayoSca | kaPasya kopaM kusumAgame ca kurvIta yadyasya hitaM tadeShAm ||’ atra kathitAyAH prAvRuShaH hemante praviShTasya SiSirasya sandeho na kAryaH || 25 || 26 ||
